decisions.reason: Weekly reassessment. Fetched docs still describe cloud sandboxes as separate from local sandboxing and usage-billed, with snapshot storage metered. They do not state a lifecycle stage, so the public-preview label is not re-confirmed here. No human date or gate is renewed.

citations.quote: Run an entire Copilot session remotely, inside a fully isolated, ephemeral Linux environment hosted by GitHub.
Cloud sandboxing is billed based on usage.
Snapshot storage is metered from the time the sandbox is stopped until the sandbox is deleted.

findings.reason: Fetched docs give no release stage, plan eligibility, or enablement path for cloud sandboxes.
findings.next: Confirm stage, supported clients, and plan eligibility in official docs; name a pilot cohort.

findings.reason: No org or enterprise policy to disable cloud sandboxes appears in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Find the policy and run a negative enforcement test for a test identity.

findings.reason: Billing text assigns usage to an owner, but token and repository scoping inside the sandbox are not evidenced.
findings.next: Document identity flow and scopes; test an out-of-scope access attempt.

findings.reason: Snapshot storage is metered, but retention, deletion, and residency terms are not in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Review snapshot retention and deletion; test with synthetic data only.

findings.reason: No approval boundary or stop control for sandbox sessions is evidenced.
findings.next: Run a prompt-injection test and confirm a human can stop the session.

findings.reason: No audit-log or session-trace evidence was fetched.
findings.next: Capture a sample trace and confirm log access and retention.

findings.reason: Billing docs describe usage metering, but spend for this tenant is unmeasured.
findings.next: Set a budget and measure a synthetic session's compute, memory, and snapshot cost.

findings.reason: Egress and firewall behavior for cloud sandboxes is not in the fetched evidence.
findings.next: Document egress controls and test an allowed and a blocked destination.

findings.reason: Support, monitoring, and lifecycle-change handling are not evidenced.
findings.next: Name an owner and a change-monitoring process before any pilot.

findings.reason: Stopped sessions keep metered snapshots until deleted; the deletion path is not evidenced.
findings.next: Document and test sandbox and snapshot deletion separately from local reset.
